technique: Bound near-field dynamic shadows
problem_solved: Shadow GPU cost grows with caster count and shadow footprint.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: RealityKit documented controls; three.js shadow maps; no Apple Maps internal claim.
expected_gain_and_basis: Potentially high if shadows dominate; remove far caster passes. No ms estimate before pass capture.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: iOS 18 projection and caster participation; include offscreen casters affecting near receivers. New cascade API is version-gated.
threejs_feasibility: Directional shadow frustum, castShadow filtering and map size.
cost_risks: Far shadows can disappear; low sun extends caster influence.
validation_needed: Shadow-on/off GPU capture; then caster/range sweep on street and aerial cameras.

technique: Screen-size building and tree mesh LOD
problem_solved: Too many triangles and details too small to read.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: MSFS projected-size selection; three.js LOD; new RealityKit native LOD docs.
expected_gain_and_basis: High geometry saving on far content; illustrative 2000 to 80 triangles = 96% per selected object, not frame speed.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Application selects authored meshes on established OS; native LevelOfDetailComponent floor unverified.
threejs_feasibility: LOD distance/hysteresis available; screen-error/FOV-aware selection authored by app.
cost_risks: Create simplified roofs/crowns; preserve silhouette; avoid double rendering during crossfade.
validation_needed: Camera orbit and FOV sweep; inspect silhouettes, transitions, main and pass-expanded triangles.
evidence_status: Mechanism verified; newer RealityKit deployment floor unverified; gain unmeasured

technique: Spatially bounded mesh instancing
problem_solved: Repeated trees, lamps, generic cars and house components consume CPU/draw budget.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: RealityKit MeshInstancesComponent; three.js InstancedMesh; MSFS instance guidance.
expected_gain_and_basis: High draw/CPU opportunity; triangles remain per visible instance. One material per group; no universal FPS gain.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Native explicit instances iOS 26; older deployment needs measured fallback. Do not assume per-instance culling.
threejs_feasibility: InstancedMesh; partition groups by cell and LOD, maintain bounds.
cost_risks: Large groups hurt culling; unique materials split groups; wind and selection need instance data.
validation_needed: Count hardware draws and CPU encode time; compare cell sizes and view changes.

technique: Material consolidation and cell mesh batching
problem_solved: Unique house meshes/material slots exceed draw limit.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: RealityKit flattening guidance; Fortnite custom LOD/material advice; three.js BatchedMesh.
expected_gain_and_basis: Illustrative 50 same-material one-draw objects to one cluster removes 98% of those draws; only when bounds/materials allow.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Merge static surfaces per cell/material; engine may flatten but verify actual passes.
threejs_feasibility: BatchedMesh or BufferGeometry merges; multidraw support varies.
cost_risks: Whole-city merges defeat culling; color variation must not require one material per house.
validation_needed: Compare total draws, overdraw and visible triangles before/after batching.

technique: Hierarchical streaming with district proxy parents
problem_solved: Far world cannot all reside at near detail; holes during loads.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Google 3D Tiles data ecosystem; Cesium; Unreal HLOD; MSFS streaming.
expected_gain_and_basis: High coverage/residency opportunity; far parent replaces many children. Proxy quality and tile content determine gain.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: App owns tile tree, proxy meshes and queues; RealityKit loads entities, not a built-in city streamer.
threejs_feasibility: CesiumJS option or custom tile tree in three.js; these are different integration scopes.
cost_risks: Offline proxy generation, versioning and bounds; retain parents until children are ready without persistent overlap.
validation_needed: Cold route, fast aerial jump, failed tile fetch, child replacement and cache churn.

technique: Frustum and horizon-aware selection before loading
problem_solved: Offscreen tiles waste network, memory and submissions.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Cesium hierarchical selection; MSFS warns oversized groups weaken culling.
expected_gain_and_basis: Potentially high for street views; depends on visible fraction. Occluded or offscreen is not the same as distant.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: App checks cell bounds before requests; renderer does final entity culling.
threejs_feasibility: Renderer frustum culling plus app tile tests; Cesium Native principles portable.
cost_risks: Conservative bounds; offscreen shadow casters and prefetched tiles have separate eligibility.
validation_needed: Rapid turn tests: no missing geometry; compare requests/residency to render-only culling.

technique: Bound memory and per-frame streaming work
problem_solved: Decode, upload and attachment bursts cause hitches or memory pressure.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Cesium cache budgets; Mapbox tile cache; RealityKit async loading.
expected_gain_and_basis: High stability gain; may reduce maximum detail. Async alone does not guarantee smooth frames.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Bound request/decode/upload/scene-attachment queues; CPU and GPU resources need explicit lifetime policy.
threejs_feasibility: Worker decoding, limited uploads/attachments, dispose GPU resources; decoded assets can duplicate memory.
cost_risks: Track source, decoded, GPU, mip/LOD overlap and in-flight assets; do not fill all available RAM.
validation_needed: Memory-pressure/poor-network route; record queue depth, peak residency and p95/p99 frame time.

technique: Opaque tree LOD then conditional impostors
problem_solved: Distant crowns consume geometry while detail is subpixel.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Horizon vegetation LOD; RealityKit billboards; three.js instanced geometry.
expected_gain_and_basis: High triangle saving possible; cards can lose on alpha overdraw. Example 300 to 12 triangles saves 96% geometry only.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Opaque crown LOD baseline; BillboardComponent iOS 18; multi-angle instance cards need custom orientation/material work.
threejs_feasibility: Instanced cards with view selection or reduced mesh; tight cutouts and no far shadow casting.
cost_risks: Aerial views expose flat cards; baked light can conflict with live sun; wind must be simplified.
validation_needed: A/B mesh versus cards for GPU fragments, memory, orbit quality and dusk lighting.

technique: Haze-linked far LOD and load cutoff
problem_solved: Far detail costs work but contributes little visible contrast.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Mapbox fog request reduction; Cesium terrain fog selection; three.js visual fog.
expected_gain_and_basis: Only saves work when selection stops or coarsens content; visual fog by itself saves no draws.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Material/background haze plus app cutoff/proxies; avoid assuming a complete volumetric atmosphere API.
threejs_feasibility: Fog or FogExp2 plus explicit tile/LOD policy.
cost_risks: Clear weather must still show credible distant silhouettes; avoid using false fog to hide all limits.
validation_needed: Clear/hazy aerial comparisons; verify reduced requests and submissions, not just appearance.

technique: Thermal-aware quality tiers and resolution
problem_solved: Warm device loses sustainable headroom despite cold-frame success.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Apple thermal APIs and Metal advice; RealityKit ARView scale guidance.
expected_gain_and_basis: Sustained stability, not guaranteed cold speed. Scale 0.75 in both dimensions means 43.75% fewer pixels, not equivalent GPU-time saving.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: ThermalState/LPM policy; ARView contentScaleFactor documented; phone RealityView equivalent unverified.
threejs_feasibility: App quality controller and renderer pixel ratio/render-target size; browser thermal state lacks a universal equivalent API.
cost_risks: Resolution affects sharpness; use hysteresis; 30fps fallback fails the requested 60fps tier.
validation_needed: 20–30 minute warm route; battery/thermal and frame-time record for each quality tier.

technique: Direction/route-aware prefetch
problem_solved: Visible tile arrivals lag walking or rapid camera motion.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Cesium sibling loading; MSFS needed-world streaming; Sunset Overdrive streaming abstract.
expected_gain_and_basis: Lower stall risk when predictions are right; wrong guesses increase bytes and battery use.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: App predicts velocity/heading or known recap route; cancels obsolete work.
threejs_feasibility: Same policy; tile tree owns priority, not the renderer.
cost_risks: Bound prefetch separately; walking GPS, orbit and teleport need distinct policies.
validation_needed: Compare cache hits, wasted bytes and time to visible detail on fixed routes.
evidence_status: Supporting mechanisms verified; WorldEngine policy proposed; gain unmeasured

technique: Coarse-first launch and cached starting block
problem_solved: Full-detail world blocks first useful interaction.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Mapbox lower-resolution raster prefetch; Pokémon GO asset-download workflow.
expected_gain_and_basis: Large perceived launch opportunity; no startup seconds promised. Raster precedent transferred to a 3D parent tile.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Ship small fallback/proxy set; load cached neighborhood first, refine asynchronously.
threejs_feasibility: Small initial glTF/proxy, deferred decoders/detail; avoid loading entire world before interaction.
cost_risks: First-frame launch and first usable 3D are separate; version caches; show loading provenance.
validation_needed: Measure cold/warm launch to first frame and first navigable 3D; test offline.
evidence_status: Supporting mechanisms verified; WorldEngine policy proposed; gain unmeasured

technique: Baked sun-independent AO and grounding
problem_solved: Without grounding, cheap near shadows look detached.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: three.js fake-shadow examples; RealityKit new lightmaps documented.
expected_gain_and_basis: Can replace selected contact/detail work; not a replacement for moving building shadows.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Vertex/texture AO or local decals as baseline; native LightmapComponent version unverified.
threejs_feasibility: Vertex colors/AO maps or simple opaque/dithered grounding; avoid large transparent overlays.
cost_risks: Fixed solar bakes contradict live time and recap; bake ambient occlusion, not noon sun.
validation_needed: Noon/golden hour/night plus rain/snow; check double-darkening and decal overdraw.
evidence_status: Mechanism verified; newer RealityKit deployment floor unverified; gain unmeasured

technique: Cascaded sun shadows as an optional quality path
problem_solved: One shadow map cannot cover far city and retain near detail.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: three.js CSM addon; newly documented RealityKit Cascades.
expected_gain_and_basis: Quality/coverage gain; may increase total shadow cost. No inherent performance saving.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: New online API floor unverified; installed iOS 26.4 lacks it. Custom Metal cascades are a major renderer task.
threejs_feasibility: CSM addon; limit splits, ranges and casters; profile backend.
cost_risks: Repeated geometry per cascade, atlas memory, seams and dynamic sun.
validation_needed: Compare bounded one-map baseline to 1/2/3 cascades under total-pass budget.
evidence_status: Mechanism verified; newer RealityKit deployment floor unverified; gain unmeasured

technique: Cheap contact/blob shadows for small objects
problem_solved: Small cars/trunks need grounding but full shadow casting is expensive.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: three.js manual fake-shadow examples; established renderer-independent geometry technique.
expected_gain_and_basis: Can remove selected caster submissions; blob geometry/fill still costs work.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Small local dark geometry/decal or authored AO; renderer-specific depth behavior to validate.
threejs_feasibility: Plane/decal with controlled blending; true screen-space contact shadows are a separate higher-cost path.
cost_risks: Do not fake large directional building shadows; snow/wetness alter contact tone.
validation_needed: Grounding readability at 5–40m; inspect depth artifacts, transparency and night.

technique: Static-shadow caching / multi-key sun bakes
problem_solved: Static city caster rendering repeats every frame.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Native lightmap existence verified; per-frame cached sun shadows in named target apps unverified.
expected_gain_and_basis: Potentially high only if cached shadow work dominates; invalidation and changing sun reduce reuse.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Established public arbitrary shadow-cache controls unverified; custom Metal or authored multi-key content.
threejs_feasibility: Custom shadow update/invalidation or multi-key lightmaps; not automatic CSM behavior.
cost_risks: Recap time scrub, weather, movers, memory and crossfades make this complex.
validation_needed: Time-scrub correctness and worst-case invalidation; measure storage and GPU cost.
evidence_status: Native lightmap existence verified; target shadow-cache controls unverified; multi-key design proposed; gain unmeasured

technique: Single sky gradient / low-resolution atmosphere LUT
problem_solved: Expensive volumetrics compete with world and shadow budget.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Ghost of Tsushima LUT/amortization concepts; simpler gradient is authored proposal.
expected_gain_and_basis: Keeps sky cost predictable; no measured saving without an existing sky baseline.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Background/sky geometry or CustomMaterial; preserve shared sun direction.
threejs_feasibility: Sky dome/fullscreen shader; optional small LUT.
cost_risks: Avoid expensive full-volume clouds as baseline; keep horizon color physically plausible for stylized art.
validation_needed: Day/dusk/night and aerial horizon; GPU pass cost and color consistency.
evidence_status: Supporting mechanisms verified; WorldEngine policy proposed; gain unmeasured

technique: Amortize sky/cloud updates
problem_solved: Slow-changing atmosphere is recomputed too often.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Ghost of Tsushima developer atmosphere presentation.
expected_gain_and_basis: Potential compute savings for costly LUT/cloud generation; simple gradient may be cheaper already.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: App updates low-resolution resources less often; custom material hooks do not expose every renderer pass.
threejs_feasibility: Render targets/LUT update cadence controlled by app.
cost_risks: Moving cloud shadows and fast time scrub need forced refresh; stale sky artifacts possible.
validation_needed: Fast recap scrub and camera motion; compare update stalls to simple static sky.
evidence_status: Supporting mechanisms verified; WorldEngine policy proposed; gain unmeasured

technique: Compressed texture formats and shared atlases
problem_solved: Texture bandwidth/residency and material variation dominate.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: three.js KTX2/BasisU; Apple Metal bandwidth analysis.
expected_gain_and_basis: Often lowers storage/residency/bandwidth for supported formats; exact ratio format/content dependent.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Author device-supported compressed assets; validate asset pipeline and fallback; avoid one huge always-resident atlas.
threejs_feasibility: KTX2Loader detectSupport/transcode; bounded workers; material-family atlases.
cost_risks: Transcoding costs startup CPU; mip bleeding and variant atlases can erase memory savings.
validation_needed: Cold decode time, GPU texture bytes, bandwidth and visual readability.

technique: Geometry transfer compression
problem_solved: Network and disk bytes slow world loading.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: three.js GLTFLoader Draco/meshopt support.
expected_gain_and_basis: Smaller payload, not automatic reduction of decoded triangles or GPU memory; decode adds CPU work.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Requires compatible importer or app-side conversion; do not assume native RealityKit handles every glTF extension.
threejs_feasibility: Configure decoder and workers; measure meshopt/Draco content-specific tradeoff.
cost_risks: Decode peaks can exceed compressed size; retain compact proxies and evict unused source bytes.
validation_needed: Bytes transferred, peak decode RAM and time to usable tile.

technique: Independent texture and mesh LOD
problem_solved: Far geometry retains unnecessarily detailed textures.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: MSFS mesh/material/texture LOD guidance.
expected_gain_and_basis: Lower texture residency and bandwidth; depends on visible texel demand, not only triangle count.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Offline coarse material families/mips; app controls asset variants; sparse-texture streaming not assumed.
threejs_feasibility: Mipmaps plus separate low-resolution far assets where necessary.
cost_risks: Multiple resident variants duplicate memory; UV and material switching can pop.
validation_needed: Aerial/street sampling, residency and texture bandwidth versus image quality.

technique: Opaque-first foliage and bounded overdraw
problem_solved: Layered transparent crowns create fragment/shadow load.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Horizon plant LOD context; Apple bandwidth analysis; billboard primitives verified.
expected_gain_and_basis: Potentially high on fill-bound frames; no gain guarantee for already-simple opaque crowns.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Opaque clustered crown meshes baseline; tight cutout impostors only if measured.
threejs_feasibility: Opaque or tight alpha-tested geometry; profile depth ordering/MSAA/materials.
cost_risks: Cutouts alias at distance; dense cards can cost more than low-poly mesh.
validation_needed: GPU fragment time in tree-heavy views; include rain/night/sun shadow passes.

technique: Visibility/occlusion-aware tile requests
problem_solved: Buildings hidden behind nearby blocks still stream and draw.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Cesium for Unreal occlusion-informed selection.
expected_gain_and_basis: Potential high in dense streets, small in open aerial views; no target-app internals inferred.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Public control/readback of native occlusion for streaming unverified; conservative app visibility or custom Metal.
threejs_feasibility: Custom hierarchical occlusion possible; do not stall on GPU readback.
cost_risks: Latency causes holes on turns; keep safety margin; approximate city occluders.
validation_needed: Dense street turn/reveal tests; avoided requests and temporal visibility correctness.

technique: GPU-driven culling and indirect submission
problem_solved: CPU selection/submission becomes bottleneck at much larger object counts.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Apple Metal GPU-driven rendering samples; Horizon GPU vicinity placement.
expected_gain_and_basis: Large CPU opportunity when genuinely submission-bound; unsuitable as first response to shadow GPU bottleneck.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Custom Metal path; not a feature toggle for RealityKit entities. Hardware/OS gate.
threejs_feasibility: Backend-dependent advanced work; no assumption that ordinary three.js WebGL exposes arbitrary Metal-style indirect pipelines.
cost_risks: Own culling, buffers, synchronization and fallback; substantial renderer maintenance.
validation_needed: CPU encode, synchronization and GPU visibility costs against simpler cell batching.

technique: Update only visible/near wind animation
problem_solved: Distant trees incur per-frame CPU/shader work without visible motion.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Vicinity-bound Horizon placement is precedent; WorldEngine animation policy is an assumption.
expected_gain_and_basis: Lower update/vertex work; gain depends on existing animation implementation.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Group parameters or shader sway; stop CPU entity updates for invisible/far tiers.
threejs_feasibility: Instance shader wind, coarse update cadence, reduced far amplitudes.
cost_risks: No per-tree material clones; keep phase deterministic across LOD changes.
validation_needed: Windy forest route; CPU entity updates and vertex cost with static far crowns.
evidence_status: Vicinity-bound precedent verified; wind-update policy is an assumption; gain unmeasured

technique: Cache resource lifecycle and pressure eviction
problem_solved: Tiles disappear but meshes/textures/source data remain allocated.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Cesium/Mapbox budgeted caches; three.js explicit resource disposal documentation.
expected_gain_and_basis: High memory stability opportunity; may cost reload latency.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Reference-count shared resources; detach entities and release tile ownership; heed memory warnings.
threejs_feasibility: Dispose unused buffers/materials/textures and image bitmaps; protect shared resources.
cost_risks: LRU alone fails if route-prefetched assets remain pinned indefinitely; reclaim in-flight buffers too.
validation_needed: Long circular route; memory returns toward stable plateau after eviction.

technique: Reduce secondary render-pass and light count
problem_solved: Extra shadowed lamps, reflection and postprocess passes exceed GPU budget.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: three.js shadow-pass behavior; Apple Metal capture workflow.
expected_gain_and_basis: Potential high if many passes are active; no reduction estimate without capture.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Pool a small near light set; use emissive windows and cheap lamp halos; actual pass controls vary.
threejs_feasibility: Limit shadowed lights, render targets and effect resolution; use emissive materials for far lights.
cost_risks: Emissive geometry does not illuminate nearby surfaces; avoid excessive transparent halos.
validation_needed: Night/rain worst-case capture; count passes, bandwidth and total submitted draws.

technique: Remove distant physics and unnecessary ECS work
problem_solved: CPU entity/collision updates scale with full resident world.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: RealityKit CPU utilization guidance.
expected_gain_and_basis: CPU/memory improvement; may not reduce GPU time.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Keep collision/interaction near camera or active dog path; group static entities.
threejs_feasibility: App simulation/update policy independent of rendering; coarse interaction proxies.
cost_risks: Maintain navigable geometry and route correctness; visible does not always mean interactive.
validation_needed: CPU scene/update traces on large resident scenes; test dog path collisions.

technique: Device/OS capability and quality tiers
problem_solved: A16, newer phones and browser GPUs support different paths.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Apple feature-set tables; RealityKit versioned declarations; web loader feature detection.
expected_gain_and_basis: Avoids unsupported paths and protects baseline; not a standalone rendering speedup.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Gate iOS 26 instances and newer LOD/cascade/lightmap APIs separately; fallback required.
threejs_feasibility: Detect renderer/extensions and compressed formats; graceful simpler materials/effects.
cost_risks: More content/test combinations; visionOS limits and APIs do not transfer automatically to phone.
validation_needed: Oldest supported OS plus A16 and newer phone; low-end web GPU matrix.
evidence_status: Supporting mechanisms verified; WorldEngine policy proposed; gain unmeasured

technique: Repeatable pass, launch and sustained profiling
problem_solved: Optimizations are chosen from unrepresentative still-frame counters.
shipped_or_documented_precedent: Apple Xcode/Metal and Mapbox performance tools.
expected_gain_and_basis: Enables reliable decisions; no direct performance gain until findings change content/settings.
realitykit_metal_feasibility: Metal capture/Instruments plus app route metrics; thermal and memory records.
threejs_feasibility: renderer.info plus GPU timing where available; include shadow passes and browser memory limits.
cost_risks: Instrumentation overhead and unavailable timer APIs; report device/OS/resolution/build.
validation_needed: Street/aerial/turn/teleport, night rain, dense trees, cold start and 20–30 minute warm replay.
